hero.title: Learn English with a partner who answers.

path.title: Start where you are
path.body: A1 to C2. Every lesson runs the same four steps: read it, hear it, write it, say it.

practice.title: You can work through a lesson — or just talk.
practice.body: 18 lessons from A1 to C2, four skills in every one. Or skip straight to 15 everyday roleplays with a partner who stays in character.
practice.roleplayMeta: 15 scenarios · seven topics · A1 to B1
practice.lessonMeta: 18 lessons · four skills each · A1 to C2
practice.skillsBody: 18 lessons from A1 to C2, three at every level. Each one runs the same loop: read it, hear it, write it, say it.
practice.gradingBody: 108 questions marked against answer keys, each with an explanation, plus writing scored against a model email.
practice.pronunciationBody: Read a sentence into the mic. An acoustic model marks each word and shows which sounds slipped.

testimonials.title: What learners say
testimonials.body: Placeholder quotes — to be replaced with attributable ones before launch.
testimonials.oneQuote: I used to rehearse a sentence five times in my head before saying it. Now I just order the coffee.
testimonials.twoQuote: The feedback tells me what a native would actually say, not just whether I was wrong.
testimonials.threeQuote: Twenty minutes on the train each morning. That's the whole routine, and it sticks because it's short.

closing.body: Start where you are — A1 to C2.

footer.blurb: English practice for every level, from A1 to C2.

meta.title: Engflex — English practice for every level
meta.description: 18 lessons from A1 to C2 with reading, listening, writing and speaking, 108 explained questions, and 15 everyday roleplays with a partner who answers.
